about: What the synthesis's records were read from and what was already known when they were stamped (work/tools/synth_state.py). artifacts: each folder's git tree as its inventory record read it. datasets: each record under data/sources/ by the sha256 of its bytes. inventory_absent: the ids of the quotes of each inventory record its text did not hold. verdict_places: the verdicts whose quotes were found anywhere but in their own artifacts. checks: the keys of the concept checks seen, each with its text.
